title: Text adventure steps
prompt:
Simulate a small text adventure. The rooms and the passages between them are:
- hall: north to library, east to kitchen
- kitchen: north to pantry, down to cellar
- library: east to study
- study: south to pantry
Every passage also works in the opposite direction (north and south, east and west, down and up are opposites), so for example the library has an exit south to the hall and the pantry has an exit north to the study. The passage between the library and the study is locked at the start. The items at the start are: lamp in the hall; key and rope in the pantry; book in the study; coin in the cellar. The player starts in the hall, carrying nothing, and can carry at most 2 items.
Process the commands listed at the end in order and print exactly one line for each:
- `go D`: if the current room has no exit in direction D, print `no exit D`. Otherwise, if that passage is locked, print `the door is locked`. Otherwise, if the passage leads into the cellar and the player is not carrying the lamp, print `too dark to enter`. Otherwise the player moves through it; print `you are in ROOM`.
- `take X`: if X is not lying in the current room print `no X here`; otherwise, if the player already carries 2 items, print `hands full`; otherwise the player picks it up: print `taken X`.
- `drop X`: if the player does not carry X print `you have no X`; otherwise X is put down in the current room: print `dropped X`.
- `unlock D`: if the current room has no exit in direction D print `no exit D`; otherwise, if that passage is not locked, print `nothing to unlock`; otherwise, if the player is not carrying the key, print `you need the key`; otherwise the passage is unlocked (from both sides): print `unlocked`.
- `look`: print `ROOM | items: I | exits: E`, where I lists the items lying in the room in alphabetical order separated by `, ` (or is `none`), and E lists the directions of all exits of the room, locked or not, in alphabetical order separated by `, `.
- `inventory`: print `carrying: I` with the carried items in alphabetical order separated by `, `, or `carrying: nothing`.
After the last command print `score S`, where S is 10 points for every room other than the hall that the player has been in at least once, plus 25 if the coin is lying in the hall at the end.
Commands, in order: look; go north; unlock east; go east; go south; take lamp; go west; go east; go down; take coin; take coin; go up; go north; take key; drop coin; take key; inventory; go west; look; go north; unlock west; unlock west; go west; unlock east; drop lamp; go south; go east; go down; look; unlock up; take rope; go north; take coin; go south; go west; drop coin; inventory.
